operation: On stock Show 101: pressed Play (transport reads 00:00.9/00:16.0 and advances); set MetaballGarden Brightness to 40% (Reset turns amber), pressed Reset (Brightness back to 100%, Reset disabled); opened the Source code readout and connected a fake Controller, whose action row shows Run and Save enabled with no readiness block.
